Class WarZoneCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.adventurecards.AdventureCard
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.adventurecards.WarZoneCard
public class WarZoneCard extends AdventureCard
Represents a "War Zone" card in the game. This card introduces challenges related to engine power, firepower, and various penalties for players. It includes logic for handling specific effects, applying penalties, and determining player statuses during the war zone phase.

    • checkRequirementsEngine

      public void checkRequirementsEngine()
      Checks if the current player can activate double motors based on available batteries and updates the game state accordingly. If the player cannot activate motors, it checks the player's engine power and determines if they are the player with the minimum engine power. Executes further actions based on these evaluations.

    • handlePlayersEngine

      public void handlePlayersEngine()
      Manages the progression of players during the engine-handling phase of the war zone. Executes player connection validation and state updates as necessary. Throws: - IllegalSetOfNextPlayerException if the next player cannot be set.

    • checkRequirementsFirePower

      public void checkRequirementsFirePower()
      Checks the player's ability to meet the firepower requirements using batteries and double cannons. - Evaluates if the current player has sufficient batteries and double cannons to activate them. - Updates the game state if the player has enough batteries to proceed. - If not sufficient, calculates and compares the player's firepower with the minimum threshold. - Updates the player with the minimum firepower if applicable and handles firepower-specific rules.

    • handlePlayersFirePower

      public void handlePlayersFirePower()
      Manages the player's firepower handling during the game. Moves to the next player or updates the current phase and state when the last player in the round has been processed. If an exception is thrown due to lack of a next player, determines the player with minimum firepower, sets it as the current player, and transitions to the dice-rolling phase. Verifies requirements for firepower handling via `checkRequirementsFirePower`.

    • finishDecision

      public void finishDecision(Set<Point> coordinates)
      Handles the completion of a decision phase based on the current state and the provided coordinates. This method processes actions related to motor, cannon, or shield activation, updating game state accordingly.
      Overrides:

      Parameters:

    • rollDices

      public void rollDices()
      Rolls two six-sided dices and applies their result to the current effect, then checks if batteries are available for additional gameplay decisions. Delegates dice rolling to the parent class implementation. Throws IllegalMethodOnThisStateException if invoked in an invalid game state.
      Overrides:
      rollDices in class AdventureCard
